blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate and efficient document layout analysis is critical for modern document parsing systems. However, although the YOLO framework represents a leading paradigm for the real-time detector, its adaptation to heterogeneous documents remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose DocLayout-YOLO, a document-specialized real-time detector that integrates diverse synthetic document pretraining and page-axis context modeling. From the data perspective, we introduce MeshLayout-1M, a synthetic pretraining corpus generated by the proposed Mesh-candidate BestFit algorithm, which provides large-scale and diverse document layouts for pretraining and improves adaptation to heterogeneous document scenarios. From the model perspective, we propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA), which captures long-range dependencies along the horizontal and vertical page axes while remaining computationally efficient. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocLayout-YOLO achieves state-of-the-art performance on four heterogeneous document benchmarks, obtaining 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1% mAP50:95 on D4LA, M6Doc, HJDataset, and PRIMA-LAD, respectively. Compared with existing real-time detectors, DocLayout-YOLO establishes a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off in document layout analysis. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/opendatalab/DocLayout-YOLO/tree/release-v2.
blocks.zh: 准确有效的文件布局分析对现代文件解析系统至关重要。 然而,虽然YOLO框架是实时探测器的主要范例,但它对各种文件的适应仍然没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议使用DocLayout-YOLO,这是一个专门使用的文件实时探测器,将多种合成文件预训和页轴上下文建模结合起来。 从数据角度出发,我们介绍MeshLayout-1M,这是一种由拟议的Mesh-candidate BestFit算法生成的合成预训程序,它为预训提供了大规模和多样的文件布局,并改进了对不同文件情景的适应. 从模型角度,我们提议Page-Axis布局注意(PALA),它沿水平和垂直页轴捕捉远距离的依赖性,同时保持计算效率. 广泛的实验表明,DocLayout-YOLO在四个不同的文件基准上实现了最先进的性能,并取得了 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1%/mAP50:95,分别为D4LA、M6Doc、HJDataset和PRIMA-LAD。 与现有的实时探测器相比,DocLayout-YOLO在文档布局分析中确立了一种优异的精度效率权衡. 代码、模型和数据见https://github.com/opendatalab/DocLayout-YOLO/tree/release-v2。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Document Layout Analysis (DLA) ( Zhong et al., 2019 ; Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2023 ) aims to locate and classify semantic regions such as text, tables, and figures, providing essential structural information for document parsing and understanding ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Cho et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , the demand for high-quality structured document data has increased substantially, requiring real-time document detectors to achieve both higher accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 文件布局分析(DLA)(Zhong等人,2019年;Pfitzmann等人,2022年;Cheng等人,2023年)旨在定位和分类文字,表格,数字等语义区域,为文件解析和理解提供必不可少的结构信息(Wang等人,2026年;Cui等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年). 随着大语言模型(LLMs)的迅速发展(OpenAI,2023;Yang等人,2025年)和检索增强生成(RAG)(Yu等人,2025年;Cho等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年),对高质量结构化文件数据的需求大大增加,需要实时文件探测器来实现更高的准确性和效率.

blocks.en:
Among existing real-time object detectors, the YOLO series ( Jocher et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Jocher et al., 2023 ) achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, yet its potential for document layout analysis remains largely unexplored. However, adapting YOLO detectors to document scenarios is non-trivial due to two critical challenges. At the data level, adapting detectors to document scenarios requires effective document-domain pretraining, which relies on large-scale and structurally diverse corpora covering rich layout variations. However, existing datasets face a trade-off among dataset scale, layout diversity, annotation quality, and so on (as shown in Tab. 1 ), while constructing large-scale annotated document corpora with fine-grained layouts remains costly ( Zhong et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2020 ) . At the model level, accurately localizing document elements requires effective structural context modeling, as document layouts contain complex long-range dependencies among text lines, paragraph columns, table grids, and figure-caption pairs ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Da et al., 2023 ) .
However, conventional convolutional YOLO architectures lack explicit mechanisms to capture such dependencies, while the Area Attention recently introduced in YOLOv12 ( Tian et al., 2025 ) is primarily designed for efficient generic visual modeling and does not explicitly exploit the horizontal and vertical organization of document pages.
blocks.zh:
在现有的实时天体探测器中,YOLO系列(Jocher等人,2026年;Tian等人,2025年;Jocher等人,2023年)实现了强烈的精度效率权衡,然而其文件布局分析的潜力仍然基本未探索. 然而,由于两个关键的挑战,使YOLO探测器适应记录情景是非三角性的。 在数据层面,使探测器适应文件情景需要有效的文档域预训,这依赖于覆盖丰富布局变化的大规模和结构多样的corpora. 然而,现有数据集在数据集尺度,布局多样性,注释质量等之间面临权衡(如Tab. 1所示),而构建带有细纹布局的大规模注解文档corpora仍然成本高昂( Zh等,2019;李等,2020). 在模型层面,精确定位文档元素需要有效的结构上下文模型,因为文档布局包含文本行,段落列,表格网格,和图封对之间的复杂长距离依赖(Wang等人,2024b;Da等人,2023).
然而,传统的革命型YOLO架构缺乏捕捉这种依赖性的明确机制,而最近于YOLOv12(Tian等人,2025年)引入的区域关注主要是为了高效的通用视觉模型设计,并没有明确利用文档页面的横向和纵向组织.

blocks.en: To overcome these challenges, we propose DocLayout-YOLO , a document-specialized real-time detector that improves detection performance through diverse synthetic document pretraining and page-axis context modeling. At the data level, we introduce MeshLayout-1M , a large-scale synthetic pretraining dataset generated by our proposed Mesh-candidate BestFit algorithm based on the principles of 2D Bin-packing ( Lodi et al., 2002 ) . By synthesizing diverse document layouts with varying elements, scales, and layout structure, MeshLayout-1M provides a more diverse pretraining corpus, allowing better adaptation to heterogeneous document scenarios.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议使用DocLayout-YOLO,这是一个文件专用实时探测器,通过各种合成文件预训和页轴上下文建模来提高探测性能。 在数据层面,我们介绍了MeshLayout-1M,这是由我们提议的基于2D Bin-packing原理的Mesh-candate BestFit算法(Lodi等人,2002年)生成的大规模合成预训练数据集。 MeshLayout-1M通过合成不同元素、尺度和布局结构的多样文件布局,提供了更加多样化的预训程序,从而能够更好地适应不同的文件情景。

blocks.en: At the model level, we propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA) , which explicitly captures long-range dependencies along the horizontal and vertical axes of document pages. By leveraging inherent page structures, PALA enables efficient context aggregation among layout elements while avoiding the computational overhead of global attention. By combining structure-diverse synthetic pretraining with page-axis context modeling, DocLayout-YOLO achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, as shown in Fig. 1 . The contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: • We introduce MeshLayout-1M, a structure-diverse synthetic pretraining dataset generated by the proposed Mesh-candidate BestFit algorithm, which enables large-scale document-domain pretraining with diverse element and layout organizations. • We propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA), an efficient context modeling mechanism that captures long-range dependencies along horizontal and vertical page axes, explicitly exploiting the inherent structural organization of document layouts while maintaining efficient computation. • We present DocLayout-YOLO, a document-specialized real-time detector integrating synthetic layout pretraining and page-axis context modeling. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on four heterogeneous benchmarks while delivering superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over existing real-time detectors.
blocks.zh: 在模型层面,我们提出Page-Axis布局注意(PALA),它沿着文档页的横向和纵向轴明确捕捉到远程的依赖性. 通过利用固有的页面结构,PALA能够在布局要素之间实现高效的上下文汇总,同时避免全球注意力的计算间接费用。 DocLayout-YOLO通过将结构多样化合成预训与页轴上下文建模相结合,实现了有利的精度效率权衡,如图1所示. • 本文件的贡献概述如下: 我们介绍了MeshLayout-1M,这是由提议的Mesh-candidate BestFit算法生成的结构多元合成预训数据集,它允许具有不同元素和布局组织的大规模文档域预训. ^ 我们提议Page-Axis布局注意(PALA),这是一种高效的上下文建模机制,它沿横向和纵向页轴捕捉长距离依赖性,明确利用文件布局的内在结构组织,同时保持高效的计算. • 我们介绍DocLayout-YOLO,这是一个文档专用实时探测器,集合成布局预训和页轴上下文建模于一体. 它在四个不同基准上实现最先进的性能,同时与现有的实时探测器相比,提供更好的精确效率权衡。

blocks.en: 2.1 Document Layout Analysis Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 文件布局分析数据集

blocks.en: Current document datasets are summarized in Tab. 1 . Existing datasets have advanced document layout analysis by providing large-scale annotations, such as PubLayNet ( Zhong et al., 2019 ) and DocBank ( Li et al., 2020 ) , or diverse document types and fine-grained categories, such as DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) , D 4 LA ( Da et al., 2023 ) , and M 6 Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . However, existing datasets still face limitations in scale, layout diversity, element coverage, or annotation cost. Meanwhile, existing document generation approaches ( Zhang et al., 2023b ; Inoue et al., 2023 ; Hui et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Kong et al., 2022 ; Gupta et al., 2021 ) mainly focus on academic-style layouts, limiting their ability to support diverse document-domain pretraining.
blocks.zh: 目前的文件数据集摘要载于Tab。 1,现有数据集通过提供大尺度说明来推进文件布局分析,如PubLayNet( Zh等,2019年)和DocBank(李等,2020年),或多种文件类型和精细分类,如DocLayNet(Pfitzmann等,2022年),D4 LA(Da等,2023年)和M6 Doc(Cheng等,2023年). 然而,现有数据集在规模、布局多样性、要素覆盖范围或注释成本方面仍然面临限制。 同时,现有的文件生成方法(张等人,2023b;伊努埃等人,2023年;惠等人,2023年;蒋等人,2023年;孔等人,2022年;古普塔等人,2021年)主要注重学术风格的布局,限制了他们支持多种文件域预训的能力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Document Layout Analysis Approaches
blocks.zh: 2.2 文件布局分析方法

blocks.en: Existing DLA methods can be broadly categorized into multimodal and unimodal approaches. Multimodal methods, such as LayoutLMv3 ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , VGT ( Da et al., 2023 ) , recently M2Doc ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and DoPTA-HR ( R. et al., 2024 ) , improve performance by leveraging text-visual interactions. In contrast, unimodal methods ( Shen and others, 2021 ; Banerjee and others, 2023 ; Banerjee et al., 2024a ; Biswas and others, 2022 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Chen and others, 2024 ) rely primarily on visual features and generic detection architectures. However, these methods either introduce additional multimodal complexity or lack explicit modeling of document-specific structural dependencies. As for real-time detectors, recent YOLO-based real-time detectors ( Jocher et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Jocher et al., 2026 ) have achieved strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through advances in detection architectures and attention mechanisms. Nevertheless, they are primarily optimized for natural images and do not explicitly exploit the structural characteristics of document layouts.
blocks.zh: 现有的DLA方法可大致分为多式联运和单式方法。 多式联运方法,如布局LMv3(黄等人,2022年),VGT(Da等人,2023年),近期的M2Doc(张等人,2024年),以及DoPTA-HR(R等人,2024年),通过利用文字-视觉互动,提高了性能. 相比之下,单式方法(Shen等人,2021年;Banerjee等人,2021年) 2023; Banerjee et al., 2024a; Biswas等人, 2022; Li et al., 2022; Chen等人, 2024)主要依靠视觉特征和通用检测架构. 然而,这些方法要么增加了多式联运的复杂性,要么缺乏针对具体文件结构依赖的明确模式。 至于实时探测器,最近的YOLO实时探测器(Jocher等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年a; Tian等人,2025年;Jocher等人,2026年)通过检测架构和关注机制的进步,实现了强大的精度效率权衡. 尽管如此,它们还是主要为自然图像进行优化,没有明确利用文档布局的结构特征.

blocks.en: 3 Diverse pretraining Documents Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3 多种预训文件综述

blocks.en: The diversity of pretraining documents arises mainly from two aspects: (1) element diversity, which covers different element categories and scales; and (2) layout diversity, which captures various page organizations such as single-column, multi-column, and magazine-style layouts. To construct a diverse and scalable document pretraining corpus, we propose Mesh-candidate BestFit , a synthesis framework that jointly considers element diversity and layout diversity (as shown in Fig. 2 ). Unlike random placement or existing generative approaches, our method explicitly controls element composition, scale distribution, and spatial arrangement to generate realistic and diverse document layouts.
blocks.zh: 预训文档的多样性主要来自两个方面:(1)元素多样性,涵盖不同的元素类别和尺度;(2)布局多样性,它捕捉到单栏,多栏,杂志式布局等各种页面组织. 为了构建一个多样化的、可扩展的文件预培训大纲,我们提议采用Mesh-candidate BestFit,即一个综合框架,共同考虑要素多样性和布局多样性(见图2)。 不同于随机放置或现有的基因方法,我们的方法明确控制元素组成,尺度分布,以及空间安排,以产生现实多样的文档布局.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preprocessing: Ensuring Element Diversity
blocks.zh: 3.1 预处理:确保要素多样性

blocks.en:
In the preprocessing phase, to ensure the inclusion of a diverse range of document elements, we utilize an initial data corpus that includes document pages and annotations as element source. In the selection of initial data, we use DocBank ( Li et al., 2020 ) as the element source due to its diverse element-level annotations, covering various document components, appearances, and scales.
Consequently, we first construct an element pool from the original annotations. Regions are extracted and noisy excessively small elements are filtered out. Finally, we organize previously retained crops into category-specific pools for subsequent sampling.
blocks.zh:
在预处理阶段,为确保纳入各种文件要素,我们利用包括文件页和说明在内的初步数据库作为要素来源。 在选择初始数据时,我们使用DocBank(Li等人,2020年)作为元素源,因为其元素级说明多种多样,涵盖了各种文档组件,外观,尺度.
因此,我们首先从原来的说明中构建一个要素库。 区域被提取,噪音过小的元素被过滤出来。 最后,我们把以前保留的作物组织成特定类别的池,以便随后取样。

blocks.en: 3.2 Layout Generation: Ensuring Layout Diversity
blocks.zh: 3.2 布局生成 : 确保布局多样性

blocks.en: Given an empty page, Mesh-candidate BestFit iteratively places elements through scale-stratified sampling and mesh-based bestfit matching. Unlike random placement or existing generative approaches, our method balances layout diversity and structural plausibility.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个空页面, Mesh-candidate BestFit 迭代地通过比例尺级的采样和基于 mesh 的最佳匹配来定位元素 。 与随机放置或现有的基因方法不同,我们的方法平衡了布局的多样性和结构的可信度.

blocks.en: 1. Scale-stratified Candidate Sampling Directly sampling elements from the entire pool may overpopulate layouts with small elements, preventing the formation of stable global structures. To address this issue, we partition elements into large- and small-scale groups based on their normalized sizes and sample candidates with a predefined ratio. This strategy preserves fine-grained elements while ensuring sufficient large regions for coherent page structures and establishing major page regions. 2. Meshgrid Construction Construct the meshgrid based on the existing layout and filter out the invalid grids that overlap with inserted elements. Only the remaining grids will be able to participate in matching with the candidate in subsequent steps. 3. BestFit Pair Search For each candidate, traverse all grids that meet the size requirement and search for the candidate–grid pair with the highest fill rate. Subsequently, remove the optimal candidate from the candidate set and update the layout. 4. Iterative Layout Filling Finally, the selected candidate is resized and center-placed to the assigned grid and composited onto the page. Repeat steps 2 ∼ \sim 4 until no valid candidate–grid pair satisfies the size requirement or the maximum number of elements is reached.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 按比例排列的候选人抽样 直接从整个池中取样的元素可能使小元素的布局过度拥挤,阻止形成稳定的全球结构. 为了解决这个问题,我们根据各要素的正常规模和预先确定比例的样本,将其分为大和小规模团体。 这一战略保留了精细的元素,同时确保有足够的大面积区域用于连贯一致的网页结构和建立主要网页区域。 2. Meshgrid 建筑 在现有布局的基础上构建 meshgrid 并过滤出与插入元素重叠的无效网格. 只有剩下的网格才能参与后续步骤中与候选人的匹配. 3. 最佳配对搜索 对于每个候选人,通过所有符合大小要求的网格,并寻找填充率最高的网格候选人。 随后,将最佳候选人从候选人设定中删除,并更新布局. 4. 最后,选定候选人的大小将调整,置于指定网格的中央位置,并整合到页面上。 重复步骤 2\\\\ sim 4,直到没有有效的候选对格满足大小要求或元素的最大数量。

blocks.en: Through the process above, elements are progressively placed into suitable regions, producing more regular and compact document layouts, as shown in Fig. 3 . Meanwhile, the generated layouts also exhibit improved alignment and higher page occupancy. The generated pages from MeshLayout-1M, a large-scale synthetic pretraining corpus containing diverse element and layout organizations, enables pretrained models to adapt to a variety of real-world document types effectively. More detailed analysis and explanations are available in Appendix E , F .

blocks.en: 4 Page-Axis Layout Attention
blocks.zh: 4 页轴布局注意

blocks.en: Document layouts exhibit strong structural regularities along the horizontal and vertical page axes, including text lines, paragraph columns, table structures, and cross-region correspondences. Capturing such long-range axis-aware context is important for accurate document element detection. Although global attention ( Wang et al., 2018 ) can model these dependencies, its computational cost becomes prohibitive for high-resolution document features. Area Attention in YOLOv12 ( Tian et al., 2025 ) improves efficiency by restricting interactions within local regions, but such partitioning may interrupt long-range dependencies across region boundaries. Motivated by the characteristics of document layout, we propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA) , which models long-range document dependencies along the page axes more effectively.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate DocLayout-YOLO on four heterogeneous DLA benchmarks: D 4 LA ( Da et al., 2023 ) , M 6 Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) , HJDataset ( Shen et al., 2020 ) , and PRIMA-LAD ( Antonacopoulos et al., 2009 ) . These datasets cover diverse document scenarios, spanning modern and historical sources, multiple languages, and diverse page structures. DocLayout-YOLO is compared with two types of methods: (1) real-time detectors, including YOLO-based models ( Jocher et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Khanam and Hussain, 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Jocher et al., 2026 ) and RT-DETRv3 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ; and (2) specialized DLA approaches, including representative unimodal and multimodal methods. Details of the comparison methods and benchmarks are provided in the Appendix B .

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparisons with State-of-the-Art Real-time Detectors
blocks.zh: 5.2 与最先进的实时探测器的比较

blocks.en: We compare DocLayout-YOLO with existing real-time detectors in Tab. 2 . N-scale: DocLayout-YOLO-N improves over the baseline YOLOv12-N by 0.7%/1.7%/4.0%/7.3% mAP on four benchmarks, while reducing latency by 11.8%. It further exceeds YOLOv8-N, YOLOv10-N, and YOLOv26-N by up to 9.0% at comparable inference speed. S-scale: DocLayout-YOLO-S delivers gains of 1.4%/1.6%/3.1%/6.2% over YOLOv12-S with 13.0% lower latency. Compared with YOLOv26-S and RT-DETRv3-R18, it achieves improvements of up to 6.6% and 4.6%, respectively. M-scale: With a latency of 3.1 ms, DocLayout-YOLO-M surpasses YOLOv12-M by 0.5%/2.4%/1.9%/5.0% and provides a 16.2% speedup. It also outperforms RT-DETRv3-R34 by up to 2.8% while using 26.3% fewer FLOPs. L-scale: DocLayout-YOLO-L improves upon YOLOv12-L by 0.9%/2.6%/0.8%/6.5% while reducing latency from 5.8 ms to 4.7 ms. X-scale: DocLayout-YOLO-X achieves the best overall results of 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1% mAP on four benchmarks. Compared with YOLOv12-X, it yields gains of 1.6%/1.5%/2.0%/6.1% together with an 18.8% latency reduction, and surpasses RT-DETRv3-R101 by up to 3.0% with comparable inference latency. In addition, PALA retains the same feature projections and positional encoding as Area Attention in YOLOv12, while standard FLOPs profiling does not account for attention aggregation, resulting in identical parameter and GFLOP counts; PALA nevertheless achieves consistently lower latency through more efficient axis-wise aggregation.

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparisons with State-of-the-Art Specialized DLA Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3 与艺术专业DLA的比较 方法

blocks.en: We compare DocLayout-YOLO with specialized document layout analysis methods in Tab. 3 . DocLayout-YOLO-X establishes state-of-the-art performance on all four benchmarks, achieving 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1% mAP on D 4 LA, M 6 Doc, HJDataset, and PRIMA-LAD, respectively. Notably, DocLayout-YOLO relies solely on visual inputs and consistently surpasses both visual-only unimodal and visual-language multimodal approaches. Compared with the previous best-performing unimodal methods, DocLayout-YOLO improves performance on D 4 LA and M 6 Doc by 1.5% and 2.6% while using only 59.4M parameters, substantially fewer than most competitive DLA models. Furthermore, unlike multimodal methods such as LayoutLMv3, VGT, and DoPTA-HR, DocLayout-YOLO does not require OCR annotations or semantic language features during inference, demonstrating that strong document layout perception can be achieved through efficient visual-only modeling. Moreover, many approaches rely on large backbones, DocLayout-YOLO maintains a lightweight YOLO-based architecture and achieves superior performance with significantly lower model complexity.

blocks.en: Tab. 4 further disentangles the contributions of MeshLayout-1M pretraining and PALA. Specifically, the MeshLayout-only setting corresponds to the original YOLOv12 pretrained on MeshLayout-1M, while the PALA-only replaces Area Attention with PALA without pretraining. Averaged across five model sizes, PALA alone improves mAP by 0.7%/0.7%/1.2%/2.2% on D 4 LA, M 6 Doc, HJDataset, and PRIMA-LAD, respectively, while MeshLayout-1M pretraining alone yields gains of 0.5%/1.3%/1.7%/4.7%. Combining both components consistently achieves the best results, with average improvements of 1.0%/2.0%/2.4%/6.2% over the YOLOv12 baseline. These results demonstrate that the gains of DocLayout-YOLO arise from both the architectural design of PALA and document-domain pretraining with MeshLayout-1M, with the two components providing complementary benefits.
blocks.zh: 标签4进一步说明了MeshLayout-1M预训和PALA的贡献。 具体来说,只有MeshLayout的设置对应了在MeshLayout-1M上的YOLOv12的原始预训,而只有PALA的预训则用PALA取代区域注意. 仅PALA在D 4 LA、M 6 Doc、HJDataset和PRIMA-LAD中就平均改进了0.7%/0.7%/1.2%/2.2%的mAP,而仅MeshLayout-1M预训就提高了0.5%/1.3%/0.7%/4.7%。 将这两个部分结合起来,将取得最佳结果,平均比YOLOv12基线提高1.0%/2.0%/2.4%/6.2%。 这些结果表明,DocLayout-YOLO的收益来自PALA的建筑设计和与MeshLayout-1M的文档域前培训,这两个部分提供了互补的好处.

blocks.en: Tab. 5 compares MeshLayout-1M with representative real-world and synthetic document pretraining datasets. Real-world datasets include PubLayNet ( Zhong et al., 2019 ) and DocBank ( Li et al., 2020 ) , which provide annotated real-world scientific pages. Synthetic alternatives include DocSynth ( Biswas et al., 2021 ) which synthesizes pages using layouts derived from PubLayNet, while RanLayNet ( Anand et al., 2023 ) adopts random placement. For diffusion-based methods, we use LayoutDM ( Inoue et al., 2023 ) and LACE ( Chen et al., 2024 ) trained on DocBank to generate layouts and then render with DocBank elements. Fig. 5 qualitatively compares synthetic layouts and pages generated by random placement, diffusion-based generation, and Mesh-candidate BestFit. For a fair comparison, we pretrain DocLayout-YOLO-S on different datasets under identical settings and evaluate downstream performance. Existing datasets show inconsistent transfer across document types, whereas MeshLayout yields increasingly consistent gains with larger pretraining scales. With 1M pages, it improves all seven document types by 1.1% ∼ \sim 3.1% mAP, demonstrating scalable and robust transfer to heterogeneous layouts.

Tab. 8 compares different attention mechanisms on M 6 Doc. Latencies are obtained on identical H200 to ensure fairness, while Memory usage is measured with the TensorRT model (bs = 1). Following YOLOv12 ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , we adjust the number of channels to ensure that all models have similar parameters and FLOPs and disable Flash-Attention.
Compared with Global Attention, PALA achieves higher accuracy with substantially lower latency, suggesting that unrestricted global interactions may introduce cross-region interference, while axis-wise constraints better match document structures. Swin performs worse because its local windows limit direct interactions across long document structures, while Criss-Cross and CSWin extend attention along horizontal and vertical directions to better capture such dependencies. PALA further combines both page axes and achieves the best 65.3%/73.7% mAP at N/L scales. Horizontal-only consistently outperforms Vertical-only, while combining both yields further gains, indicating the importance and complementarity of horizontal and vertical dependencies in document layouts. More explanations and analysis are available in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work presents DocLayout-YOLO, a real-time detector specifically designed for document layout analysis. DocLayout-YOLO adapts the YOLO paradigm to heterogeneous document layouts by combining large-scale synthetic document pretraining with MeshLayout-1M and efficient long-range page-axis modeling with PALA. Extensive experiments show that DocLayout-YOLO achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks and consistently delivers a superior accuracy–efficiency trade-off over existing real-time detectors.
blocks.zh: 这部作品呈现了DocLayout-YOLO,一个专门为文档布局分析设计的实时探测器. DocLayout-YOLO通过将大规模合成文档预训与MeshLayout-1M相结合,以及高效的长程页面轴建模与PALA相结合,使YOLO范式适应多样的文档布局. 广泛的实验表明,DocLayout-YOLO实现了跨越多个基准的最先进成果,并始终提供优于现有实时探测器的准确性-效率权衡。

blocks.en: We also carefully adjust RT-DETR settings for optimal performance and a fair comparison. blocks.en: Tabs. S5 and S6 evaluate robustness under 12 document perturbations at three severity levels on PubLayNet-P and M 6 Doc-P, respectively ( Chen and others, 2024 ) . P-Avg denotes the average accuracy over all perturbations, while mRD measures normalized performance degradation, with lower mRD and higher P-Avg indicating stronger robustness. On PubLayNet-P, DocLayout-YOLO-X achieves 97.5% clean mAP, 85.8% P-Avg, and 48.7 mRD, improving over baseline YOLOv12-X by 0.6%/9.1% in clean mAP/P-Avg and reducing mRD by 30.7. It also surpasses the previous best RoDLA by 15.8% on P-Avg while lowering mRD by 67.3. On M 6 Doc-P, DocLayout-YOLO-X achieves 75.5% clean mAP, 68.0% P-Avg, and 118.8 mRD, outperforming the baseline YOLOv12-X by 1.5%/0.3% in clean mAP/P-Avg with a 2.6 reduction in mRD. Compared with the previous best results, it further improves clean mAP/P-Avg by 5.3%/6.3% and reduces mRD by 28.8. These results suggest that DocLayout-YOLO provides improved robustness to diverse document degradations without noticeably compromising clean-document performance.

blocks.en: To further examine the learned spatial representations, we visualize the third-stage (S3) feature maps of the X-scale YOLOv12 baseline and DocLayout-YOLO. This improvement is especially evident in layouts with strong horizontal and vertical dependencies, where PALA maintains coherent responses across related elements while suppressing irrelevant background activation. blocks.en: Fig. S4 illustrates the structural differences between PALA and representative local attention mechanisms. Swin Attention restricts interactions within local windows, while Area Attention partitions the feature map into disjoint regions, preventing direct context aggregation across region boundaries. Criss-Cross Attention extends interactions along both spatial axes in parallel, but jointly normalizes horizontal and vertical attention weights. Axial Attention instead performs separately normalized axis-wise attention sequentially, making the second direction dependent on the output of the first. In contrast, PALA performs horizontal and vertical attention in parallel with separate normalization, allowing the two directional contexts to be modeled independently while preserving long-range dependencies along both page axes. This design preserves complementary horizontal and vertical structural cues without local partitioning, cross-axis competition, or directional-order dependency.
blocks.zh: 图S4说明了PALA与有代表性的地方关注机制之间的结构性差异。 Swin Content限制本地窗口内的互动,而"区域注意"则将特征图分割成脱节区域,防止了跨区域边界的直接上下文聚合. Criss-Cross Region 沿着两个空间轴平行延伸相互作用,但共同使横向和纵向的注意力权重正常化. 相反,轴心注意按顺序分别进行正轴式注意,使第二个方向依赖于第一个方向的输出. 相比之下,PALA在独立正常化的同时进行横向和纵向的注意,使两个方向背景能够独立建模,同时沿两个页轴保持远距离的依赖性. 这种设计保留了互补的横向和纵向结构提示,没有局部分割,横轴竞争,或方向顺序依赖.

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations & Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Efficiency across deployment environments. PALA achieves favorable practical efficiency with optimized attention implementations. Its actual speedup may vary across hardware platforms and inference backends due to differences in kernel optimization and memory access. Further operator-level optimization could improve its portability and efficiency across broader deployment environments.
blocks.zh: 跨部署环境的效率。 PALA通过优化关注的实施,实现了有利的实际效率. 由于内核优化和内存访问的不同,其实际速度可能因硬件平台和推论后端而异. 进一步优化操作人员一级可提高其在更广泛的部署环境中的可携带性和效率。

blocks.en: Modeling scope of PALA. PALA is designed around the dominant horizontal and vertical organization of document layouts, enabling efficient long-range context modeling along both page axes. While this design covers common document structures well, highly irregular layouts with strong rotation, perspective distortion, or non-axis-aligned arrangements may benefit from more flexible interaction patterns. Extending PALA with adaptive directional modeling is a promising direction for such scenarios.
blocks.zh: PALA的建模范围. PALA的设计围绕文档布局的主导水平和垂直组织,能够沿着两个页轴高效的远程上下文模型化. 虽然这种设计很好地涵盖了共同的文件结构,但具有强烈旋转,视角扭曲或不轴对齐安排的高度不规则布局可能得益于更灵活的相互作用模式. 以适应性定向模型扩展PALA是这种情景的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Synthesis scope of MeshLayout. MeshLayout focuses on increasing structural diversity through controllable geometric layout synthesis, with its current element pool primarily constructed from DocBank. Expanding the element sources could further increase diversity in content, language, and visual appearance. In addition, incorporating richer semantic relationships and realistic document variations could further narrow the gap between synthetic and real-world documents.
blocks.zh: MeshLayout综合范围。 MeshLayout专注于通过可控几何布局合成来增加结构多样性,其目前的元素池主要由DocBank建造. 扩大要素来源可进一步提高内容、语言和视觉外观的多样性。 此外,纳入更丰富的语义关系和现实的文件差异,可以进一步缩小合成文件与现实世界文件之间的差距。

blocks.en: Future Work. Future work will explore more portable implementations of PALA and adaptive context modeling for irregular document structures. For MeshLayout, we plan to expand multilingual and multi-source element pools and incorporate richer semantic and visual variations, further improving the diversity and realism of synthetic document pretraining.
blocks.zh: 未来工作。 未来的工作将探索更便捷地实施PALA和对不规则文件结构的适应环境模型。 对MeshLayout来说,我们计划扩大多语种和多源元素集合,并纳入更丰富的语义和视觉变化,进一步改善合成文件预训的多样性和现实性.
